name: Mosbius Floating Social Bar
author: mosbiusdesign

sections.description:
Mosbius Floating Social Bar is a lightweight and powerful plugin that adds a sticky floating action bar to the bottom of your WordPress site. It is perfect for mobile-first designs, allowing your visitors to easily contact you via WhatsApp, Phone, or find your location.

Features:

  • Customizable Icons: Choose from popular icons like WhatsApp, Phone, Location, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), TikTok, and more.
  • Live Preview: See your changes in real-time within the admin panel before saving.
  • Layout Options: Switch between Horizontal (bottom fixed) and Vertical (side fixed) layouts.
  • Easy to Use: Simple drag-and-drop interface (in future updates) or easy add/remove functionality.
  • Responsive: Optimized for mobile and desktop devices.
  • W3C Compliant: Valid HTML5 and CSS3 markup ensuring compatibility and best practices.
  • Lightweight: Minimal CSS and JS for fast loading times.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/mosbius-floating-social-bar directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Click on the ‘Mosbius Floating Social Bar’ menu item in the admin dashboard to configure settings.
sections.faq:
Can I change the colors?

Yes, you can select from predefined style classes for each button (e.g., Whatsapp Green, Instagram Gradient, etc.).

Is it mobile friendly?

Absolutely! The plugin is designed with a mobile-first approach.
